items.description: A multilingual greeting cycles on a calm white surface, then a curved black curtain rises from below to reveal the landing — the boundary stays a single smooth arc the whole way up, never a flat slide.

items.name: service-ledger
items.title: Service Ledger
items.description: A scroll-spy services section with a sticky tab strip at the top. As the reader scrolls past each long-form panel (title, description, deliverables, optional image, inline CTA), the matching tab highlights; clicking a tab smooth-scrolls to that entry.

items.name: multi-media-testimonial
items.title: Multi-Media Testimonial
items.description: A masonry grid of testimonial cards that mix text-only quotes, image thumbnails, and video clips that open in a mobile-framed lightbox powered by Video Player Pro — with author avatar, title, and role under each card.

items.name: pricing-landing-hero
items.title: Pricing Landing Hero
items.description: A service-style landing hero with scattered preview cards, price block with strike-through, scarcity line, dual CTAs, and trusted-by strip.

items.name: tabbed-hero-section
items.title: Tabbed Hero Section
items.description: A SaaS hero section with left-aligned headline, tabbed navigation, app screenshot showcase, and trusted-by logo strip.

items.name: split-hero-section
items.title: Split Hero Section
items.description: A split-layout hero section with left-aligned headline, key metrics, app screenshot showcase, and trusted-by logo strip.

items.name: hero-title-animation
items.title: Hero Title Animation
items.description: An animated hero title with phased brand reveal, staggered word blur-in, and highlight box sweep effect.

items.name: pricing-section-vertical
items.title: Pricing Section Vertical
items.description: A vertical pricing section component with feature comparisons, plan cards, and call-to-action buttons.

items.name: card-stack
items.title: Card Stack
items.description: An interactive 3D card stack carousel with fan-out animation, drag gestures, and auto-advance support.

items.name: glass-ai-card
items.title: Glass AI Card
items.description: iOS 26 liquid-glass content card with animated skeleton lines and hue-rotating gradient AI action button.

items.name: glass-shipment-flow
items.title: Glass Shipment Flow
items.description: iOS 26 liquid-glass shipment flow diagram with animated travelling-light SVG paths connecting stacked order cards.

items.name: phone-mockup-card
items.title: Phone Mockup Card
items.description: A minimal phone frame card with pixel-perfect status bar, dynamic island, and typography metrics display.

items.name: navbar-simple
items.title: Navbar Simple
items.description: A clean, simple navigation bar with logo, links, and action buttons.

items.name: navbar-centered
items.title: Navbar Centered
items.description: A navigation bar with centered navigation links between logo and actions.

items.name: navbar-with-search
items.title: Navbar With Search
items.description: A navigation bar with integrated search input and keyboard shortcut indicator.

items.name: navbar-user-menu
items.title: Navbar User Menu
items.description: A navigation bar with user avatar, dropdown menu, and notification bell.

items.name: navbar-status
items.title: Navbar Status
items.description: A navigation bar with status indicator and real-time metrics display.

items.name: navbar-breadcrumb
items.title: Navbar Breadcrumb
items.description: A navigation bar with breadcrumb navigation for multi-level hierarchy.

items.name: navbar-floating
items.title: Navbar Floating
items.description: A floating pill-shaped navigation bar with rounded corners and backdrop blur.

items.name: navbar-tabs
items.title: Navbar Tabs
items.description: A two-tier navigation bar with main header and tabbed navigation below.

items.name: navbar-minimal
items.title: Navbar Minimal
items.description: An ultra-minimal navigation bar with just logo, few links, and single CTA.

items.name: navbar-split
items.title: Navbar Split
items.description: A navigation bar with links split between left and right sections.

items.name: navbar-icon-links
items.title: Navbar Icon Links
items.description: A navigation bar with social media icon links and primary CTA.

items.name: button-copy
items.title: Button Copy
items.description: iOS 26 liquid-glass copy pill with AnimatePresence icon crossfade.

items.name: button-dropdown
items.title: Button Dropdown
items.description: iOS 26 liquid-glass pill with spring chevron and staggered glass dropdown.

items.name: button-split
items.title: Button Split
items.description: iOS 26 liquid-glass two-zone pill with primary action and dropdown options.

items.name: button-badge
items.title: Button Badge
items.description: iOS 26 liquid-glass pill with floating spring-animated notification badge.

items.name: checkbox-simple
items.title: Checkbox Simple
items.description: A simple checkbox component with label and optional description.

items.name: checkbox-indeterminate
items.title: Checkbox Indeterminate
items.description: A checkbox with three states: checked, unchecked, and indeterminate.

items.name: checkbox-colored
items.title: Checkbox Colored
items.description: A checkbox with customizable color themes including blue, green, red, and more.

items.name: checkbox-todo
items.title: Checkbox Todo
items.description: A todo-style checkbox with animated strikethrough effect when checked.

items.name: checkbox-terms
items.title: Checkbox Terms
items.description: A checkbox for accepting terms of service and privacy policy with linked text.

items.name: checkbox-group
items.title: Checkbox Group
items.description: A group of checkboxes for multi-selection with horizontal or vertical layout.

items.name: checkbox-tree
items.title: Checkbox Tree
items.description: A hierarchical tree checkbox for nested selections with expand/collapse.

items.name: comment-thread
items.title: Comment Thread
items.description: Threaded comment component with nested replies, colored avatars, and collapsible reply chains.

items.name: profile-card
items.title: Profile Card
items.description: A glassmorphic profile card with two variants — full-bleed image overlay and split half layout. Includes follow button, favorite toggle, and verified badge.

items.name: scroll-text-rise
items.title: Scroll Text Rise
items.description: A scroll-driven text reveal — each word fades up from below as you scroll, with staggered opacity and y-translate transforms powered by Framer Motion's useScroll and useTransform hooks.

items.name: scroll-tilted-grid
items.title: Scroll Tilted Grid
items.description: An editorial two-column image grid where pairs of stills rise from below tipped forward, settle into focus, then tilt away over the top edge as the page scrolls. Optional infinite loop appends more cycles via IntersectionObserver.
